mapper.sql: id, workspace_id, req_id, title, content, content_brief, status, owner, owner_user_id, created_at, updated_at
mapper.select: SELECT d.id, d.req_id, d.title, d.status, d.owner, d.created_at, d.updated_at, r.name AS req_name, d.content_brief AS content_brief, COALESCE(tc.task_count, 0) AS task_count, COALESCE(tc.done_count, 0) AS done_count FROM requirement_doc d LEFT JOIN requirement r ON r.id = d.req_id AND r.workspace_id = d.workspace_id LEFT JOIN ( SELECT req_doc_id, COUNT(*) AS task_count, SUM(CASE WHEN board_column = 'done' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS done_count FROM task WHERE workspace_id = #{workspaceId} AND deleted_at IS NULL AND req_doc_id IS NOT NULL GROUP BY req_doc_id ) tc ON tc.req_doc_id = d.id WHERE d.workspace_id = #{workspaceId} ORDER BY d.updated_at DESC
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO requirement_doc (id, workspace_id, req_id, title, content, content_brief, status, owner, owner_user_id, created_at, updated_at) VALUES (#{id}, #{workspaceId}, #{reqId}, #{title}, #{content}, #{contentBrief}, #{status}, #{owner}, #{ownerUserId}, COALESCE(#{createdAt}, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP), COALESCE(#{updatedAt}, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP))
mapper.update: UPDATE requirement_doc SET req_id = #{reqId}, title = #{title}, content = #{content}, content_brief = #{contentBrief}, status = #{status}, owner = #{owner}, owner_user_id = #{ownerUserId}, updated_at = NOW() WHERE id = #{id}
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM requirement_doc WHERE workspace_id = #{workspaceId} AND req_id = #{reqId}
